name: After § 37
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 37a. Notes the need to agree on NDCs for 2035 before COP30; calls on the Council, by indicating an EU target, to take a pragmatic approach and take into account current geopolitical challenges, while ensuring a fair and level playing field and protecting the competitiveness of EU companies;
